name: automattic/media-explorer
description: Extends the Media Manager to add support for external media services.

prepare-ci: bash bin/install-wp-tests.sh wordpress_test root root localhost

scripts-descriptions.coverage: Run tests with code coverage reporting
scripts-descriptions.coverage-ci: Run tests with code coverage reporting and send results to stdout
scripts-descriptions.cs-fix: Run PHP Code Sniffer and fix violations
scripts-descriptions.i18n: Generate a POT file for translation
scripts-descriptions.lint-ci: Run PHP linting and send results to stdout
scripts-descriptions.prepare-ci: Prepare the environment for integration tests
scripts-descriptions.test: Run all tests for the Media Explorer plugin
scripts-descriptions.test-ms: Run integration tests for the Media Explorer plugin in multisite mode
